samples.question: Four pip-labeled cells start as shown (filled = ON, ring = OFF), and the small triangle marks the cursor's starting cell. Read cards 1 through 8 from left to right. A triangular STEP card moves the cursor to the next label in the cycle 1→2→3→4→1. A filled circular SET card makes only the cursor's current cell ON; a ring-shaped SET card makes only that cell OFF. SET does not move the cursor. After all cards, how many cells are ON? Answer 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4.
